scope: person-level fictional oncology time-to-event methods lesson, applicable as teaching methods to cancer research broadly; current breast-cancer book provides narrative only
scientific_question: Under an invented right-censored event process, how does a fixed Cox model compare with a training-only Kaplan-Meier null prediction for 24-month event-free survival?
unit_of_analysis: one independent invented person, one baseline row, no paired specimen categories

observation_schema.name: person_id
observation_schema.validation: unique, nonempty, generated S001..S240; no real barcodes or personal identifiers

observation_schema.name: marker
observation_schema.validation: invented standard-normal assay-like score; not a named gene

observation_schema.name: time_months
observation_schema.validation: observed time > 0, <= 60, single origin; no latent times in model input

observation_schema.name: event
observation_schema.validation: 1 observed fictional event, 0 right censored; never specimen category

endpoint.fictional_event: first invented recurrence-like event; not verified clinical recurrence or death
endpoint.time_origin: invented baseline observation at month zero

partition.split_algorithm: R sample.int(240) with reserve_seed; first 60 person IDs reserved, 180 remaining development; all IDs explicit and sorted within sets
partition.outer_algorithm: R sample.int(180) on sorted development people with fold_seed; assign consecutive blocks of 60, each person one held-out outer fold
partition.reserved_policy: never used for fitting, diagnostics, censor-weight estimation, predictions, selection or model comparisons in this G4 run

cox.learning: training fold only; fixed unpenalized formula; no search or stepwise feature selection
cox.train_diagnostic: cox.zph on training fold only; report without acceptance-driven refitting

null.prediction: training-fold Kaplan-Meier event-free survival at 24 months for every held-out person

evaluation.primary: person-equal out-of-fold IPCW Brier at month 24 for Cox and Kaplan-Meier null; also Cox minus null (negative favors Cox)
evaluation.outcome_indicator: I(observed event-free beyond month 24), observed when event at/before 24 or measured time >24
evaluation.censored_early: time <= 24 and event == 0 contributes zero weight, not a negative event label
evaluation.weight_denominator: number of held-out people, not sum of weights; sum contributions across 180 outer-held-out development people then divide by 180
evaluation.censor_weight_fit: each outer training fold only; Ghat is reverse Kaplan-Meier and Ghat(time-) uses left limit at an observed event
evaluation.support_fail_condition: reject Ghat(24) < 0.20 or any nonfinite/nonpositive required Ghat, no extrapolation
evaluation.secondary: held-out Harrell concordance of Cox linear risk score, higher means higher event hazard; censoring bias noted; no threshold-based selection

calibration.style: descriptive fixed probability bins for predicted event-free survival
calibration.observed: Kaplan-Meier survival at month 24 within each out-of-fold bin
calibration.insufficient_policy: mark bin unavailable with denominator, do not tune bins or claim CI

evaluation.diagnostics: report observed event/censor count by development/test fold and horizon, censor-survival support, Cox coefficients, cox.zph train-only values and warnings

quality_gates.infeasible_protocol: fail closed and preserve failure record; do not search for a favorable seed or change horizon
quality_gates.check_leakage: disjoint person IDs across reserved and all fold splits; each development person tested in exactly one outer fold
negative_cases: Cox score confused with absolute survival probability
quality_gates.output_storage: new directory outside public Git; no CI artifacts containing rows, model objects or predictions

guidelines: TRIPOD+AI 2024 reporting recommendations as an educational benchmark; not a clinical report
Graf et al. 1999 survival prediction score
Prince et al. 2025 IPCW censor estimation considerations
reporting.disclaimer: SYNTHETIC RESEARCH AND EDUCATIONAL USE ONLY. NOT FOR CLINICAL USE. No diagnosis, treatment, patient prognosis, or biological discovery.
reporting.limitations: Internal cross-fitted teaching case, one observation per invented person; censoring assumed independent, no full procedure uncertainty or external/clinical validity.
reporting.admission_note: D0 remains draft; D1 real TCGA-BRCA study blocked, and any other real oncology dataset requires independent source-specific admission.
